notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=sX9JzTATVAI;full][/previewyoutube]

Marla
The leader of a union consisting of Lucas' closest friends and assistants. A woman who maintains her hope until the last moment and has the courage to even give her life for this cause. She descends to the world with Lucas. She organizes the people living on the island and triggers a resistance against omega luma. She is really smart.

Lucas
The leader of the planet Vega, who received training from martial arts masters at a young age, is the one who will inherit his father's legacy. When Omega Luma engulfs the planet Vega in flames, Lucas lands on Earth with a spaceship, but the experiences he experiences cause him to lose his memory. You must reach the warrior spirit like in the old days, Lucas.

Omega Luma
One of the lords of darkness who came from the Luma lineage that lived in ancient times. Their ancestors caused disasters in the universe and with great luck our world remained free from these disasters. Omega Luma wants to reach Lucas' father's secret heritage and treasure and then kill Lucas. So will the Earth be destroyed like the planet Vega?

Arthur
He may look weak, but he is a true warrior. He has defeated many enemies one-on-one and is a master of using weapons. Lucas must get help from Arthur. Otherwise, disaster will be inevitable.

Andrew
His passion for the sea, which started at a young age, led him to an island under pirate rule. Andrew shows his wisdom to those around him with his experienced and calm nature. If he had received military training, he could even have become a general. Who knows?

BILGE
A strange and mysterious woman. The mushrooms she has been dealing with lately have an effect on her brain, and her skills and knowledge are extremely high. Although no one knows when she came to the island, she has a secret of her own.

NOAH
He is a funny and honest person. After working as a tourist guide in Europe, he falls into the hands of pirates during a trip and starts to serve them. His intelligent personality and ability to foresee events can help Lucas.

notes.title: Dark Days : Devil Hunt Season 2 [Chapter 6]
notes.notes:
Episode 28(Harry and the Lovely Helper)

Harry quickly turned his head towards the cave entrance, feeling the chill of hearing a human voice due to his loneliness for a long time.

The owner of the voice seemed to be a little boy not far away.

With fear and anxiety, he approached the source of the sound, taking slow and cautious steps, holding his halberd tighter.

When Harry saw what was standing in front of him, he did not hide his surprise and called out to him. This was not a person!

This creature, which looked like a small and cute red rabbit but spoke like a human, was asking for his help.

Harry:

+Who are you! How can you talk..! What are you doing here ! Or am I dreaming…!!
-No no..Please don't hurt me.My name is Charlie..

+Charlie.. I want to know who you are..Why did you come here..How can I trust you!

-Please do not misunderstand. Me and my family are a race that has been living in these mountains for years. My intention is not to harm you, please do not misunderstand. My family was attacked by bears and I had to escape from them. When I wanted to go back, I had already lost the way. Please help me… I am worried about my family. .And I'm very hungry..

Harry wanted to be cautious about this strange creature asking for help. He wanted to trust his words, but he would not help him until he gave him satisfactory answers to a few questions in his mind.
+I will help you, but there is a question that you must answer to me. No one, including my people, has ever mentioned your existence.. Not even the people who lived in these surroundings.. Are you a demon in disguise that looks beautiful and cute? So, how do you know our language? I have never seen a living creature other than a human speaking.

Charlie;

-I and my ancestors are creatures that can be considered half-human, descended from a human race that was cursed by a demon many years ago and were forced to live on this mountain. Most of my ancestors and my family died of a disease we do not know about.

+Demon! Who is this and why did he curse you..!

-I don't know who and why he is, but according to rumors, his name is Azazil. I want to kill him!!!

Harry was startled when he heard the name Azazil. He was a very powerful enemy and, depending on his actions, skilled in magic. He wished not to encounter him.

+Azazil... hmm okay, I'll help you. It's quite hot inside the cave, please don't stop, go in..

The two companions of travel and destiny had a common enemy, and Harry was no longer alone. They shared the last pieces of meat from the deer together.

As they sat around a warm fire, Harry began to trust this cute red creature with rabbit ears.

He trusted his words. He had never heard the name Azazil before, but he was convinced that the demons attacking their village were the demons of this enemy.

Harry spoke up and placed the piece of meat in his hand on the ground.

+Do you know that I lost my way and my father too..

Charlie was surprised..

-What! Are you serious..

+Yes, a red devil wanted to carry me somewhere with his hand.. He seemed to be talking about the cellars.. Other devils massacred my people.. I don't know if my father is alive or not.. The last time I saw him, he was trying to save me.. I hope he is alive..

Harry couldn't help the tears in his eyes when he told what he had experienced.
Charlie wanted to support him..

Charlie;

+I want you to believe that your father is alive... If we both lose our faith, we will have lost our faith from the very beginning. I will help you in any way I can. Let's get out of this place and find your father. We have nothing to lose.

Harry's confidence in this friend he had just met increased even more. He wiped the tears from his eyes with his hand and a smile appeared on his face.

Harry;

+Well then, let's leave this cave after finishing our meal. We have enough weapons for a fire and an attack. Don't be afraid, God is with us.

Charlie and Harry became good friends from the first day and were determined to act in solidarity with each other in their work.

They would finish their last meat in the cave and continue their way towards the northwest.

A secret enemy was watching them behind the mountains...

notes.title: Dark Days : Devil Hunt Season 2 [Chapter 5]
notes.notes:
[b]Chapter 26(The Way of Ares)[/b]

Ares questioned his attitude towards this mysterious person who introduced himself as a magician. Was he supposed to follow her?

It was not time to think. Time was working against Ares every minute.
Choosing to trust him, she followed the man.

Reece introduced himself and they continued on their way.

I am that person who makes all wizards understand and master their magical abilities. Why are you so nervous and restless?

Ares couldn't say anything..
Reece smiled and continued.

+Or are you still thinking about Harry?

Harry..?

Ares was stunned again. Who was this man?

Ares ;

You are the most valuable and greatest wizard here, right?

Reece smiled..Yes, I will teach you magic skills too.

Callum doesn't know what's going on in the world. I wanted to let him know but then I found out from the crystal ball that you came here...

+Crystal ball..?

Yes, Ares. This sphere is also in Azazil. Believe me, there are only a few of them in the world.

I cannot know the future and what will happen in the future, but as I learned from my master, our job is difficult now that these demons have come to the world once again.

My master..? Who is the person you speak of as master? Ares asked excitedly..

My master's name is Robert..!!

Since Ares had never heard this name before, it seemed like just another wizard to him. This attitude of Ares caught Reece's attention.

“Come with me,” Reece said. He showed Ares a secret passage in a secret cellar, where all the ancient secrets and books of the past were kept, and told him to enter.

He reassured Ares by saying, "Everything is just beginning."

[b]Chapter 27(Great Expectations)[/b]

Harry's hopes for life were increasing as the hours passed, as a result of his experiences and all the positive results.

From now on, the meat left from the deer would be enough for him for a while, and it would be enough for him in a warm environment like a cave.

All these events were enough for Harry for the moment, but he was still slowly feeling worried about the future.

The negative thoughts he created in his mind were settling into his consciousness, even if only slightly, pushing him into great uncertainty.

The food source would also run out quickly, the meat would spoil even if it was not eaten after a certain period of time, and the bear danger could arise again after a certain period of time.

One bad thought after another was enough to hold Harry captive.

There were 2 days before the meat spoiled, which was enough for Harry to come up with a new plan.
It seemed like a very correct way to first decide where he was, find his way according to the signs around him, determine where his village was and make his plan accordingly.

Harry was actually quite intelligent and talented.

Despite his young age and such bad events, his efforts were admirable.

He needs to stay in the cave for 1 more day, and during this time, going out and finding the polar star at night and marking the north direction will give him confidence.

He lit a big fire with his flaming halberd here all day long, and it was very warm and safe inside. If he was lucky and the sky was cloudless, it was not difficult to find the pole star.

It was estimated that his village was in the north-west direction and there was a lot of rough and mountainous terrain waiting for him to overcome.

Harry went out.

First, he quickly checked his surroundings for predators. He held the halberd in his hand tightly, giving himself the confidence to fight when necessary.

It looked pretty cold outside.

The sky was quite clear. This was a good time for Harry.

When he raised his head, it was not difficult to find the pole star and determine the direction of north. It was as if he had learned this from his father for those times.

His village was located to the west of the pole star.

Harry's prediction was correct, and finding his way to his village was a great source of hope for him.
He was about 50 meters behind the cave. The cold weather made him cold and even his clothes were about to freeze. He had to turn back.

When he turned his head towards the cave path, he heard a voice.

It was a call for help.

notes.title: Dark Days : Devil Hunt Season 2 [Chapter 4]
notes.notes:
[b]Chapter 25(The Dwarf King's Decision)[/b]

When Ares entered with his glasses, he found himself in the middle of a large hall, also decorated with gold and precious metals, behind the bright and magnificent door.

Despite the low light illuminated by the dim sunlight, the interior looked very bright and beautiful.
Ares was experiencing such a large and magnificent palace with his own eyes for the first time and was visualizing how he would talk to the king in accordance with his purpose.

He would want something clear from him.

But dozens of words were running through his mind.

Ares walked into the hall with quick steps. In front of him was a serious king waiting with an ax in his hand.

When Ares saw the king, the words in his mind began to vary one by one. He had to do whatever he could to choose the right word.

Meanwhile, Ares approached the king and called out to him.

Ares:

+Dear great Callum, king of Shangri-La. I feel very lucky and honored that you agreed to meet with me. I came here to meet with you and get your help on an issue that threatens the world.
Callum slowly hit the ground with the ax in his hand and began to stare at Ares.
The words that would come out of his mouth would either give Ares hope or disappoint him.

Callum:

+So the future of the world is in danger? So why don't I know about this, dear Ares?
Ares wasn't sure how to react to Callum's statement. He was astonished and saddened by the attitude of other people on this issue, as he and his people were the only ones who knew about the existence of the truth.

Ares:

+Sir, my son has been kidnapped. The enemies have destroyed our city. Please, I request your help. Let the talented and knowledgeable wizards in this place help me train me.
Callum went into a long thought.

A strange man says that the fate of the world is in danger, but he doesn't have a single proof. Maybe he will abuse the magic ability he will learn? Who knows..?
Callum's answer was No!

Turning to Ares;

You have proven yourself strong enough to enter here, but I cannot help you with magic. This skill tree is only given to good and virtuous people. You are quite unreliable in this regard. I'm sorry Ares... I will not help you.

Ares had to go out of the palace accompanied by the king's guards, not knowing how to compose himself and what to say after Callum's answer.

All these negativities and experiences left Ares deeply disappointed and dragged him into a deep depression where he couldn't even figure out what to do.

Ares came out of the door with these thoughts. As he came out of the door, a white-haired old man grabbed his hand and pulled him. He called out;

Hey fool, where are you going, I'm Reece, the king of wizards, I know what's on your mind, follow me...

notes.title: Dark Days : Devil Hunt Season 2 [Chapter 3]
notes.notes:
[b]Chapter 23(Dwarf King Callum)[/b]

The doors of Shangri-la were finally opened for Ares. He passed Ethan's test and was finally given permission to meet the dwarf king Callum.

This place, which was very majestic and magnificent and contained many beauties made of gold and brass, left Ares astonished.

The people inside looked calm. It was as if they were a people who did not consider their wealth to be stronger than themselves, were content with little, and meditated by combining their souls with their own consciousness.

Who could have thought of such an interesting and strange place?

Ares wanted to see a few people with magic talent, take lessons from them, and specialize in this field.
His physical abilities seemed sufficient. He was strong and intelligent.
But he had not yet reached spiritual maturity.

The words Isabella said to Ares about this place had a place in Ares' ears and consciousness, and he thought for a long time about what flowery gardens were.

A person pursues and must pursue a certain goal throughout his life.

Working without giving up for this purpose and goal and never losing faith nourishes one's being and soul and ensures peace in one's life. Dreams and hopes that become successful after a certain period of time take people to flowery gardens and give them what they want to achieve.

All you need is faith and work on this path.
Everything was finally starting to make sense.

Ares continued on his way, not bothered by the mysterious people looking at him.
Hoping that Callum would be inside the palace, he told the guards at the door that he wanted to go in and talk to the king about something.

The guards were really big and strong.

They wanted to give a chance to this man who successfully passed Ethan's test.

Ares just had to wait.

After waiting a few minutes, the great king invited Callum Ares to his presence.
Ares put on the sunglasses given to him by his son years ago, whose origin and origin are unknown, and entered the room.

The king was going to tell him something he didn't know.

[b]Chapter 24(Great Fight)[/b]

Harry was thinking of finding a source of fire next to the deer meat killed by the bear and feeding himself. He could make sparks by rubbing the stones together and thus start a small fire. This was the first thing that came to Harry's mind.

He wanted to go out. It was so cold and icy outside that his little body could not resist the freezing cold and he would succumb to hypothermia.

His first aim was to quickly search around for stones and fire starter.

A strange object he saw somewhere in the distance caught his attention.

As he moved forward, he saw the corpse of a green creature he had never encountered before.
Yes, this being was none other than a goblin.

What could have happened here? More importantly, how and when did this body get here and how did it die?

There could be many more similar creatures around.
Harry was very defenseless.

An object in the Goblin's hand caught Harry's attention.

At the tip of an ancient halberd-like weapon, there was an undying flame that would burn forever.
Harry approached the goblin and took the halberd from his hand.

He was no longer defenseless, and this halberd was covered in some kind of magic.
It seemed so.

Harry didn't know how to use it.
He wanted to try it. He hit the stone ground with a moderate swing with the halberd in his hand.
Harry was going to witness a moment he had never encountered before.

The halberd produced a bright and hot flame wherever it touched, and its power almost never ended.
This flame shook and frightened Harry a little.

But all this didn't seem like a fluke.

Destiny was following Harry.
Quickly running back to the cave, Harry would struggle to feed himself, cook the meat, boil the snow water and survive.

He managed to light a fire with the halberd in his hand and a few flammable logs he found outside.
He was now very well warm and, most importantly, had a food source.

The effects of hypothermia diminished on his body as the hours passed.
Harry was more vigorous and hopeful than before.

Deep thoughts suddenly echoed in Harry's mind.

notes.title: Dark Days : Devil Hunt Season 2 [Chapter 2]
notes.notes:
[b]Chapter 21(Harry and the Mysterious Cave)[/b]

Despite all his father's efforts, Harry was kidnapped by the devil. Unfortunately, Ares couldn't help it and Harry came face to face with death.

Meanwhile, a hunter who was watching what was going on around had shot the demon right in the heart using a blue magic arrow.

It was like a thin line of fate.

Now Harry was fighting for his life all alone on the side of a desolate and cold mountain.
Harry fainted from fear and the pain of hitting the ground when he fell, but the fainting wouldn't last long.

It was almost dusk when he woke up, and Harry was on the verge of hypothermia from the extreme cold.

He had to find a very urgent source of heat or death was inevitable.
Harry knew this. His father had taught him survival skills even at an early age, told him what to do in difficult situations and warned him and his surroundings.

Perhaps all these teachings were for this purpose. Nothing was for no reason or in vain. Harry was now alone and had to do whatever he could to get out of here.

He stood up.

A long road, like a cave, appeared before him. There could be predators inside and there was no place to find a warm place outside the cave. The only solution was to enter this cave and find a fire source and create it if necessary.

His cold hands and feet were about to succumb to hypothermia, and it was as if the numbness was spreading throughout his body.

He entered the cave.

What a terrible thing it was for a small child to resist all this and try to survive. Not everyone could show this determination and effort.

It was pitch dark inside, it was evening, and the sun had disappeared.
At this moment, Harry heard a roar from inside. Fear had overcome the hypothermia and all of Harry's hope was now fading.

[b]Chapter 22(Life and Death)[/b]

Harry realized that the source of the sound was coming from a distant place.
He urgently needed to overcome his fear and not stop trying.

He found a hiding place among the rocks to his right. The sound source pointed to a bear, and Harry could hide among these rocks.

He went in and hid.

Harry had stepped right into the heart of the heat when he needed to search for a source of heat. His hiding place was safer and warmer than the other feathered places. The voice was getting closer and closer to him.

Harry was praying to God. There was nothing left for him to do. It was the right thing to do. After doing all his hard work and what he was going to do, one should trust him. One should not lose faith for a moment.

The bear rushed out of his side and left.
The danger seemed to have been averted for the moment.
He had fallen asleep from exhaustion and the warmth of the rocks he had sheltered in. He needed to rest.

The hypothermia was getting better and he was about to get over the tiredness.
How bad it was for all this to happen to a child. Faith and determination had been given to Harry by God, perhaps as a reward.

The desire to reach his father and village, whose fear had been erased from his body, had now become more dominant.

It was the next day. Harry had to find food. For water, he could melt the snow he found around and drink it. He wanted to get out of the rocks where he took shelter.

When he lifted his head, he realized that there was no sound and no sign of life in the surroundings.
The bear obviously hadn't been here very long and hadn't made a nest.
He started walking.

There was a dead deer inside. Last night it was obviously bear food.
This was a good sign.

All he had to do was make a fire, cook the leftover meat from the deer, and heat water.
But there was nothing around to light this fire.

Harry fell into thought.

notes.title: Dark Days : Devil Hunt Season 2 [Chapter 1]
notes.notes:
SEASON 2

Chapter 19(Duel)

Ares had finally arrived at the gate of the magnificent palace. This journey had taken longer than he had expected. The compass was pointing in the direction he was following, Shangri-La. The magnificent palace was not really an imaginary place, it was quite a mystical and mysterious place, and there were highly magical magicians lurking inside. .

When Ares arrived at the door, he was greeted by a rather large, strong man, who, he thought, was an expert in magical abilities. The man turned to Ares, greeted Ares, and began to speak.
+Hello, welcome to Shangri-La, seeker of truth. The man whose desire to learn ravages his body and soul. I'm Ethan.

I don't know why you came here, but everyone who comes here has to pass a test.
Ares interrupted and called to Ethan thoughtfully;

Ares: What? Is it an exam? Can't get in? I don't have much time, Ethan. Believe me, we are in big trouble. The world is on the verge of extinction, please help me get inside!

Ethan smiled and handed Ares an ancient yellow sword. He turned to Ares again and called out to him!
Ethan:You will be subjected to a physical test to enter here. With this aura-inducing sword in your hand, come on and attack me.

If you can beat me, you can enter through this door.
Otherwise, I will neither believe what you say nor help you get in!
Ares accepted the duel without hesitation.

Chapter 20(A new beginning)

Ethan wanted to test Ares by telling him to lunge with his blue aura-inducing sword.
It was obvious that Ethan had a strong and combative personality, both physically and mentally, responsible for Shangri-La's safety. Ares had no choice but to gain this man's trust in order to pass the exam.

The first move came from Ares. He fearlessly attacked Ethan with his sword. Ares knew that this person could not be easily defeated, and he learned this in the first move. Ethan responded to Ares' attack with his own sword, and it didn't take long for him to stop.

Ethan shouted again. Attack fearlessly!

Although Ares was skilled at wielding a sword, the man before him looked very strong.
But somehow she had to beat him.

Ares was both responding to Ethan with the sword and trying to get the negative thoughts out of his mind.

At this moment, Ethan smiles at Ares;
Is the life of your loved ones so unimportant to you. What are you waiting for!
Ares was startled.

After a few seconds of silence, Ares' aura power began to increase with tremendous acceleration.
Ethan was feeling it. He seemed to realize in himself that this man was truly strange and that he had never met anyone with so much potential before.
The duel raged on.

Ares was only gradually controlling and increasing his own aura, which was focused on battle.
And finally, Ares unleashed such an aura that it almost broke Shangri-La's door. The aura knocked Ethan down and shattered the sword in his hand.

Ethan now understood that this man would become a very strong warrior if he was truly trained. Controlling his mind and body was not for everyone. If Ares was emotionally focused on something, his strength increased tremendously. This man had to be given a chance.

Ethan called out to Ares once again!

foreign!

You've passed the exam, you've earned your ticket to Shangri-La. Inside, our dwarf king Callum is waiting for you.

Come before him! May Shangri-La bring you peace and wisdom.

notes.title: Dark Days : Devil Hunt Story 8 [End of Season 1]
notes.notes:
Chapter 18(Pandora's Box)

  The guiding and mysterious mage brought the treasure hunter team to the slope of an unknown mountain.

They needed a password to get in. The old man knew what the password was. As he knew all the mysterious and historical events that happened in the past..
Returning to the gate of the mountain, he used the Radix magic and called out..

tectum..

Radix was a root spell, Tectum was a cipher.
Radix created a green root with the cipher, creating a gateway through the mountain and a gateway to the team.

The treasure team's trust in this old and mysterious old man has increased and they have no choice but to accept him as a guiding guide.

An old and historical cave path was waiting for them. Inside, there were bats, many blind animals that had not even seen the light of day, and an atmosphere that frightened the crew.
They followed the cave path for a long time.

After an hour or two of hard travel, Noah called out to the others, pointing to a room across the street.
Yes, we have come to the end of our path.

A treasure that has never been seen before is waiting for you inside, what are you waiting for, enter and get the treasure!

While the 3 people were looking at each other and discussing what to do, the old man next to them suddenly disappeared.
The mage had disappeared like smoke using his magic skill, perhaps it was all the work of a hallucination.
A sudden fear and anxiety gripped everyone.

What was going on?

Who was this man.. Oh my God, please let all of them be a good sign.
Richard wanted to give up by telling the others that they didn't know they would.
John, on the other hand, turned to Richard;

Dear brother, I sense something good in this. I will go in and open the door of the room, please do not contradict me. Now I am content with my fate.
Richard and Joseph could no longer think clearly and felt in their own way that they had to obey John.
Together they headed for the door.

Inside was a box of medium size and not grandiose, but it must have been filled with treasure.
With one move, John unsealed the box, lifted it with his hands, and the magic of the necromancer who had imprisoned all the demons in this box years ago by using the death magic was dissipated.
Smoke appeared from the box and suddenly destroyed the cave.
Once again, this scourge had spread to the world, humanity was now in a state of extinction, evil had rapidly engulfed the world like a black smoke.

Azazil was free now, surrounded by a whole lot of demons, goblins, golems, ogres and dragons. His servants were at his disposal.
What would it be like to stop them now, who would do this job,

Will the whole world be destroyed and become a devil's nest…?

notes.title: Dark Days : Devil Hunt Story 7
notes.notes:
Chapter 16(The Mysterious Old Man)

The treasure hunter team awakens from their dreams in fear.
Joseph is looking at the other two brothers, a feeling of deep fear in the group and a cold icy feeling that they don't even know what to do with it. Anxiety was growing like a mountain.

When they awoke, the mist had cleared, the sun was right above them, and they were undecided, curious and hopeful, contemplating their destination, as if in a spring air.
After a long silence, John was the first to speak.

Tell me what's going on. Have you both had the same dream?
Richard and Joseph joined John. They could do nothing but shake their heads.
They fell into a deep questioning of what would happen or what they would achieve, why they had set out on this path.

Now they had to make a decision and determine what to do.
John first came up with the idea of going back.
He told the others that there was something they did not know on this road anymore and that if they continued on their way, they would cause great trouble.

Yes, the team had to go back now.
According to the map in their hands, the target they wanted to reach was about 3 km away, pointing to a secret passage in a steep mountainous terrain.

The ancients explained this very well with the saying that the goal to be achieved is actually ourselves.
Maybe this was the end of the road for the team.
They all packed up and prepared to go back home.

As they were about to set off, an old man with white hair, which they did not recognize, wearing old clothes and holding an ax, saluted and began to speak.
I know very well what you are looking for and for what purpose you set out. Follow me,
I own the map you have.

Chapter 17(Location of the Treasure)
The team became deeply suspicious when the old man said that he owned the map and why they were here.
Why should they believe what they say?

Maybe he had watched them from afar as they were dreaming and then decided what they were doing.
Maybe he wanted a share of the treasure.
John turned furiously at the old man;

How do you know us, who are you? You said you own the map.
So how can we trust you?

The old man smiles;
I am a wizard who knows ancient inscriptions and historical events from a far country, even the passage in the chamber of secrets, who knows the ancient past.
I came to you for help. Please don't get me wrong.

The map in your hand belongs to the great king Osidon in the elven land, showing the gold treasure in an ancient room.
I am his grandson Noah.
When Joseph found the map, he remembered a bird guiding him.

Noah told the team something they didn't know before Joseph had to say he was talking about a bird;
The bird that guides Joseph is my alpha magic.
You have this map with this spell.. Moreover, I knew the existence of this bird without you telling it.. So don't be suspicious and follow me..

Let me show you this gateway to secrets, the way to the treasure.
Now you can trust me..

Joseph was startled by what was said. There was no one around when he found the map. How could this old man know that he was following a bird?
Although there are many animals around?

Undecided, the treasure team wanted to follow the old man and benefit from his vast experience.
Their desire to return home was again replaced by a search for treasure, this time.
The old man was showing the way to go.

This time, their luck was not 33 percent, but straight to the heart of the treasure, the 100 percent correct target.
They continued on their way with the old man. The mysterious man was going to determine their fate and the whole world...

notes.title: Dark Days : Devil Hunt Story 6
notes.notes:
Chapter 15(Azazil and the Demon Army)

Azazil, who has great and wide powers in the mana realm from the ancient angels, is a Devil who was expelled from his presence and cursed by God because of his jealousy towards humans.
When he lands on earth, this devil with two horns and red skin is determined to take over the whole world and destroy the human race.

All suffering had to end.

Yes, the necromancer would do it with the help of the greatest magic.

Azazil was pouring evil and disaster in his great and magnificent palace with his army of devils. One day he got up and turned to his soldiers and said;

I am looking for a way to solve this problem radically. A way that will soon bring the end of all humanity and take over the world..

Diabolos, Azazil's most trusted and loyal demon, intervened;
Sir, I suggest a way. The magic talent we have is insufficient. Let's steal the talents of the elves with highly developed magic skills on Earth, and give ourselves power.

This will increase our abilities and wipe out the entire race of the world.
Seeing Diabolos' proposal as logical, Azazil called out to Diabolos;

Well gather all your armies, capture the most skilled mages in the countries you designate, and kill and torture those who do not serve us.
Azazil, not even a fraction of his old angelic state, was attacking the human race with all his being to spread death and disaster.

At that moment, the necromancer appeared from the door. Yes, the war was approaching. The fate of the world would be determined after this war.

Chapter 15.1(The Great War)
Robert entered through the door of the magnificent hall. There was an army of demons around him and an evil aura engulfed the entire hall. Robert Azazil turned;
O the devil! Today I will put an end to your life and tyranny. Now all suffering will end. Your death will be by my hand!

Azazil was hiding his surprise at this old man who suddenly appeared before him and heeded the words of the old wizard.

The sorcerer's words were not empty. He was confident in something.
This old man might have possessed a power they did not know about magic in terms of the subject they had just discussed. Azazil began to speak cautiously;

O human, old sorcerer. You've come to my door, obviously you're talented. But you can't afford to kill me.
I am Azazil, the king of the entire demon army. Don't hesitate to show off all your skills!
I will crush you into dust and bury you with the others. Remember, I have a huge army and very skilled soldiers. If you want to fight me now, don't hold back!

Although he did not hesitate to fight Robert Azazil, he was heartbroken. His doubts had stifled his faith. What if he failed?

What if it all goes to waste? What should he do? No, there was no need for fear or worry. This job would be successful with a small aura of death magic.

Suppressing all his emotions, Robert called out to Azazil;
O demon and evil creature. I will bury you in history. My aura in my right hand will be enough to tear you apart. I will not stop until I crush you into dust.

Instead of fear and anxiety, Robert was surrounded by confidence and determination. He surrendered to his fate, believing that he would never give up on the path he knew.
Robert first created a blue aura on his right hand.

This was neither too little nor too much to begin with. The spell he used was called Amour.
Azazil started laughing when he saw Amour. Turning to Robert;

“What, are you going to destroy me with this?” He drew his big and wide sword in his hand.
Azazil was indeed a very powerful demon. He knew exactly what to do and how to fight.
He dealt a great blow to Robert with his sword, destroying the old mage's entire aura.

 Danger bells were ringing. Whatever he did, Robert had to concentrate and focus on the aura of the Death Spell.
It was the only solution, but Azazil did not give him the opportunity. The Devil's army, on the other hand, did not interfere with the war on Azazil's instruction and wanted to see how their masters would win a great victory from afar.

All the demons were watching them confidently.

Chapter 15.2(True and False)
Frustrated by the Amour spell, Robert then cast his strongest spell, Bellum. Azazil was constantly preventing him from casting spells and was being clever.

He answered Bellum with his sword.

There was a 2 percent aura of death magic in the magic. Therefore, it was a very strong aura, and Azazil did not hide his surprise at this event;

I understand that you are gradually increasing your strength.. Well, you're not the only one using aura, are you? He started laughing saying..

Azazil suddenly surrounded him with a red aura. His strength was almost unbelievable.
Even the demon army around him was frightened and took cover. Robert had only one move left.
This time he was sure of what to do.

If Robert used 10 percent death magic aura, his body wouldn't be able to handle it and he would die within seconds.

Suddenly Azazil returned and activated Pena, the 8 percent death magic aura. The two master great warriors were sharing their trump card and the fate of all humanity would now be determined as a result of this war.

Azazil's aura was almost 8 percent equivalent to a death magic aura.
It wasn't easy to stop Azazil.

Robert needed to increase his aura by another 2 percent to defeat him, and his whole body knew he wouldn't be able to handle it.

He couldn't risk it. Even if he increased his strength, another move might come from Azazil. For a short while, he gathered all his mind and activated Pandora's box..

Yes, even if Robert couldn't kill Azazil, he could have imprisoned him in a box.
He combined all his strength with both hands and increased his aura to 10 percent and combined his entire demon army with Azazil's aura.

Then Azazil turned and imprisoned the demons and Azazil with a neat and one-shot move towards the pandora's box.

Robert's death was only seconds away, and he used those seconds to seal Pandora's box and cast a spell in case Azazil's soul might emerge from it in the future.
All the people of the world were freed from this scourge.

While Robert was breathing his last, the future events were shown by God for a brief moment.
Robert's last sentence was Harry.

notes.title: Dark Days : Devil Hunt Story 5
notes.notes:
Chapter 13(Shangri-La)

Holding Jacob's compass in his hand, Ares continued on his way with conviction, on a road he did not know but trusted in the steep mountainous terrain to the northeast. It was as if he knew what to do.
Maybe Jacob's words had affected him, and indeed Ares was going to make a move that would change the fate of the world.

  It was her greatest desire to save her son, but she also knew that she was powerless.
Years ago, Ares had been supported by his wife Emily, who died when his son was born, warning him against difficulties and guiding him with words of confidence and hope.

Ares had never forgotten his wife, and now he wanted Emily to be there for him, who could support him in the face of difficulties. However, one cannot have every wish and one should keep himself ready for all difficulties and not lose his faith.

The compass pointed to a great mysterious region of gold and brass, majestic and majestic, on a mountain to the north.
Ares continued on his way. An unexpected event was waiting for him at the door.


Chapter 14(Dream Realm)

Although John, Richard and Joseph were in their own dreams, it was as if they had found themselves in the same dream and moment.

On the horizon was the vast sea and the seagulls, a quiet and calm mysterious island and a glow shone.
Everyone was looking at each other, unhurriedly calm and unaware of their existence and situation, without even being asked where they were.

Joseph was the guide again. Pointing with his hand to the island opposite, he shouted..Hey! You see, that's where we need to reach our goal. That's what we set out for, right.. Finally, our dreams will come true..

Come on, what are you waiting for, get ready .. first we will follow the sound of the seagulls. Then we have to sail to the vast sea and reach that island.

John agreed with Joseph. If they acted together as a team, their success was inevitable.
Richard was thoughtful. He always had the aftermath on his mind and was trying to act cautiously.
The Treasure Hunter team set out. In front of them, the clear sea, the nesting seagulls and their eggs, the peaceful calmness and the goal they were trying to reach, which they felt in their entire being, were in their palms.

They followed the path. There was one small obstacle in front of them. John lifted Richard, supporting him with his hand.

When Richard saw a seagull and its newly hatched chicks in front of him, he told his friends that they had to continue in another direction so as not to disturb the family's comfort.
John and Joseph underestimated what Richard had said by not listening to him.

John:
So what! Are we going to change our target for a bird. Joseph, you think too emotionally..
Look, we set out on this road for a treasure to reach our goal, and whatever comes our way cannot make me give up on my path!

Joseph gave John the right. Richard had to follow the team again and John cleared their way by dissolving the slot with one move.

Seagulls and chicks, on the other hand, quickly moved away from their scattered nests to another place.
This was something they shouldn't have done. God had given them another option, but they had made a mistake once again because of their selfishness.

Rejecting all options one by one, they headed towards the seashore, unaware that they would worsen the situation with their selfish and evil self insistence on committing sin.

Now their distance to the sea was reduced to half a kilometer, as if the island was in front of their eyes.
At that moment, an unexpected event occurred. While the island turned into dust and ice before their eyes, the sea became a ball of fire.
And the seagulls had become the devils...

notes.title: Dark Days : Devil Hunt Story 4
notes.notes:
Chapter 11(Ares and the Talented mage)

The way of all beauty and light is shangri-la..
It had been exactly 16 days since Ares left home. In his difficult journey, he had met at least one enemy almost every day, crossed the mountains, crossed the plains, and continued on his way without losing hope of finding his son against all difficulties.

He had finally reached the Eastern realm, Tandogan. He had to wait for now because Isabella had given him such information.

I wonder if he had to wait for the wizard. What if he couldn't find his son?
What if that wizard really isn't here? How much could he trust Isabella? No, it should have gotten rid of all negative thoughts. He had done the best he could. To follow your destiny and path.

Ares watched the public and the established market for a long time with deep feelings and thoughts. It was clear that there was no demon attack on Tandoğan at this time.
Obviously, people were ignorant of the state of the world and their happiness would not last long.
Ares began to roam the market. All people were preoccupied with their own troubles on certain issues, immersed in their own lives.

Should Ares have warned them of the evil? Ares answered this to himself. No! He had to talk to that wizard because he had a reason.

He was suffocating, where is this wizard? There were no signs.
When he arrived at the end of the market, a black cat looked at Ares and began to meow.
A black cat brought bad luck. But it was a simple superstition. Ares looked at the cat. The cat was going to drag him down a path.

He followed the cat.
A few blocks away, the cat disappeared. What did that mean or did it make sense?
.Ares had to follow the cat because he had the guts to believe it. He entered a door, the cat was last seen through that door.

Ares began to move forward, and he heard a deep, powerful voice behind him. The owner of the voice was none other than the wizard he was searching for.

Chapter 12(Welcome Ares)

Ares could not hide the surprise and fear that appeared in his face when he saw a gray-haired old man who seemed to be an expert in all kinds of magic, since he had no magic talent before.
Ares wanted to make his first sentence, meet the man in front of him and try to explain all that happened.

Before he could speak, an event occurred that he was very surprised at. The magician recognized himself and called Ares by his name.
Confused, Ares didn't know what to say, and Harry was the first sentence.

-Hey, you sure know more than me.
Are you going to help me?
The old man smiled and used the Belapora magic with his hand.
This spell instantly showed real events on an object like a crystal ball. Yes, Harry was in the crystal ball, and Ares called out to him, excited to see his son for the first time in a long time.

Unfortunately, his voice did not reach across and the spell was over.
The old man's name was Jacob, and the spell he used was a kind of portal-opening spell.
It was started to be done by the ancient dwarves in this world, and with this magic they learned from their ancestors, they were reaching the precious metals and locating them.

For now, he had helped Ares for a short time. Ares turned to Jacob and asked again!
-Where is my son now! I... have to save him..
Jacob thought he should tell Ares all that had happened and realize the horror of the situation and tell him what he had to do.

Ares, I know who you are and what you've been through.
I heard with my own ears that the demons swore to capture the soul that was now born in a person and not to re-enter the archenemy, Azazil.
But unfortunately I have no talent against this scourge. Even the spells we use are not enough to destroy them all. Azazil cannot be stopped.

We have only one hope of salvation, and that is to protect this spirit born in a child and use it once again for the destiny of our people and the entire world when necessary.
Jacob did not tell Ares how terrible it was to use this spell and that the person who used it could not bear it, and that a child would die, moreover, that a child would not be able to resist this spell. In fact, Jacob did not know in which child this spirit was born.

+Ares! I will teach you your magic skill and I believe that when the time comes, you will make a move that will change your destiny. First, follow a compass I'll give you.
Arm yourself with all your weapons in case something unexpected happens to you.

Shangri-La is waiting for you..

notes.title: Dark Days : Devil Hunt Story 3
notes.notes:
Chapter 9(Cave road 1 month ago)

John, Joseph and Richard were on their way to the unknown on this path that opened to them in a curious and excited way. Who knows, maybe the two brothers, who respect this belief without even questioning where Joseph discovered it, are aiming towards the just cause of their hopes.
They were on their way. There was no one but these three in the desolate forest. There were no traces of living things around them. John was startled at this moment. He had heard a sound. The presence of a voice in such a quiet environment for a long time caused some fear in the team. The voice belonged to an animal. Joseph He soon realized what this animal was.

A 3 headed dragon.
All three people were almost shocked. No matter how much Joseph refused and mocked the situation, the event was happening right before their eyes. The worst thing was that they had nothing but an ax to defend themselves and a few digging tools. Even if they did, they couldn't deal with the dragon.

Meanwhile, the dragon disappeared.
For a long time no one had even seen these creatures. had God shown a piece of the future? Who knows…

He looked towards John Joseph, and Richard gestured the path, and they were in a deep silence. It was as if fear had imprisoned their bodies. They wanted to follow this path non-stop for now. There was no obstacle that could stop them for the moment.

They suddenly realized that they were dizzy and their stomachs almost turned them into a prison, and they couldn't help falling to the ground and suddenly fainted. Deep sleep lowered their blinds. The dream they would soon see was just like a piece of the future. Yes, they were on a road they shouldn't have done and God was giving them a choice. Fate. was following them.

Chapter 10(The Sorcerer and Death Spell Years Ago)
In ancient times, an evil that was deadly to elves, dwarves, and the human race had invaded the world. Humanity had to survive. There was no other way, but how could it be? All the weapons and powers in their hands were not enough to kill these demons. The archenemy Azazil could not be stopped.

Azazil was raining death with his great sword and magic skill in his hand. With many golems, goblins, dragons, and demons after him, he was attacking from everywhere and sworn to destroy humanity. Such a scourge could not be stopped. At a time when the end of world humanity was imminent, a talent appeared. It was none other than a death spell.

The Death Spell was above all powers and was the kind of power to destroy demons and was bestowed upon those chosen by God. But it had a downside. Anyone who used this power would die.
An enormous aura brings great destruction. No creature can lift this aura.

A 70-year-old wizard named Robert was the one chosen by God who would have this aura. The death spell was now in his presence and under his control. He had only one right. He had to control this power well.

There was almost no margin of error.
One night, Robert dreamed of two apple trees. One was forked and neglected, and the other was a tree full of apples and leaves. Robert suddenly woke up and went out. He panicked at what he saw. Maybe it was just a dream everyone would see. It was a veritable dream with profound consequences, and Robert had already realized it.

One tree meant death, the other life. Life would continue human life. If he chose death and failed, all humanity with him would vanish from this world like the vanishing tree. God had given him this message and all he had to do was control this consciousness and maturing aura.

He retreated into a deserted, snowy mountain cave with a few supplies and belongings he had taken alone. He was trying to strengthen his aura. Controlling the death spell was not that easy. His strength increased day by day. He first created an aura with his right hand, then destroyed it with his left hand. It was a seemingly simple but very effective method. Like yin and yang. Absolute harmony of good and evil.

Finally the days passed. Now, Robert had managed to control a certain part of the death spell's aura, albeit a small one, and this aura would be enough to destroy all the demons in the world.
Robert left the cave where he had taken refuge.

He was prepared for war. Now it was time for all demons to be wiped out from this world, and this would be done by Robert with God's help. He had only one right, and he had to use it against the arch demon Azazi. He probably must have trapped all the demons in a Pandora's box. It wasn't anyone's place to seal it up so it wouldn't open again and then sacrifice himself.

Yes, Robert was preparing for war. He crossed mountains and plains. Finally, Arch Demon Azazil was waiting for him.

notes.title: Dark Days : Devil Hunt Story 2
notes.notes:
Chapter 7 (Beyond the Mountains)

Before he set off, Ares set up camp in the middle of an unfamiliar valley, with the halbert ax he had taken with him, his sharp pointed spear, and a few supplies.

At the point where he set up camp, something he had never encountered before was happening. When he lifted his head, a circular area appeared in the sky. It was not a good omen.

Ares fearlessly watched the sky. It must have been a trick of the demons. I wonder if his son was alive, what would he do in this situation? Would magic always be enough in talent?

As he was asking himself these questions in his mind, a big red powerful demon appeared behind him.
Ares had to don his armor, or he would find himself seriously injured in a single blow.

Chapter 7.1
Ares suddenly stood up. He donned his armor and tried to oppose the demon with his ax in his hand. Many words were running through his mind at that moment.

Harry, Conor, Isabella, my people...
It was as if everything came together in one spot.
He couldn't give up, he couldn't stop, he had to keep going, and most importantly, he had to be strong. It was as if the fate of the world was in his hands.
And suddenly the voice of the demon was heard:
+It was pointless and stupid but he was saying.. "Harry"

-Ares was very surprised. How did he know about Harry. What was the purpose of these demons?
+Ares replied.Who are you? Where did you come from and how do you know Harry?
The demon said you'll never know
and Arese struck a blow.

Chapter 7.2

Ares responded with his sword. The thin and sharp sword forged by the ancient elves severed the demon's arm. Ares took a deep breath and said:
How do you know about Harry and where is Harry now?

He knew he knew.

One child will change the fate of the world. We don't know who he is, but Harry is mentioned a lot. It may be him, but we must find all the children and remove the spell from their souls. You will not be the winner!

Ares got angry and finished off the demon.
What did that mean? What was the demon talking about. Would Harry change the fate of the whole world?

Chapter 8(Brothers in Search of Treasure1 month ago)

John and Richard, two treasure-seeking brothers, are people with a stubborn spirit who are obsessed with searching for their own destiny by following a map inherited from their grandfather and getting rich more than the treasures they will find in their dreams.
While John is a bit more aggressive and extravagant than Richard, Richard has a calmer and more docile character. One day, his friends Joseph, who came to their house, suddenly said that he discovered a mysterious mark on the treasure map.

He goes in and greets and shouts:
+I found out what eagle's nest and three-headed dragon mean!
- Both brothers John and Richard shine in their eyes and John excitedly asks Joseph:
Come on Joseph, tell me what does it mean?

-Joseph:

A nest is pointing to the source, while the 3-headed dragon is 3 different ways. Each path can lead to different treasures or there is only one treasure. But the most important detail is the dragon!

-Richard interrupted.
+You're not talking about a real dragon, are you?
-Joseph laughed. No of course! Dragon means destiny. We have to choose one of 3 different paths. If we do not choose the right path, we cannot leave these paths and we will die of hunger and thirst. But if we choose the right path, our destiny will turn to people with a rich and glorious title and the dragon path will lead to us. What do you think?

-Richard pondered for a long time. They had almost a 33 percent chance, and they had no proof at all. It was not worth the risk. Just then, turning to his brother, John Joseph, he said:
We are on our way right away. I set out on this road with all my faith and efforts. God is always with us. He said don't forget.

Although Richard was hesitant, he had to comply with the team. One winter time, they set out around the heavy snow and fog with their digging items and three or five provisions. Unaware that they would plunge the world into evil…

notes.title: Dark Days : Devil Hunt Story
notes.notes:
Chapter 1

wake up dad..
Shouldn't we catch more fish?
-Yes, son, I have a bit of a headache today, so I wanted to sleep, ahh anyway, where were the fishing rods, let's catch them immediately, otherwise it will be too late, otherwise the fish will scatter in their nests, right?
Yeah yeah let's hold it
Sometimes I think of my mother, I wish the room was here with us right now, she would pat my head and say, what a beautiful day, my son..
-Yes..
I really miss her
-Me too, son..

Chapter 2
Ares and his son Harry were out for a stroll in the beautiful spring weather, trying to catch their dinner by fishing. When it was a little late, Ares turned to his son and said:
-That's enough, we should go home, Harry..
+ No, a little more please..
-Come on Harry, believe me, I have a headache. I should go home and rest.
- well, dad..

Chapter 3

While returning home, suddenly there was an explosion.
+What's going on here like this? Harry stay with me!
-Dad, I'm so scared..
+ Damn, where did the demons come from, come on, run, run..
Perhaps he had to somehow act on his ax and sword. The alarm bells were ringing. At that time, many goblins and demons appeared around. As Ares continued to run quickly, he saw the injured Connor and said to him:
-Connor, you're going to be okay, who the hell is this?
+ I'm fine, Ares demons.. I don't know where they came from, they will kill us all.
-Let's go! Harry come here!!

Together they enter Connor's house. They had saved their lives for the moment. Ares was feeling confused and tired, and the goddamn headache just wouldn't go away.


Connor addressed Ares:
+A sword! Take this, I'm very hurt. The rest you protect our people please I believe in you.
- All right, connor, please don't tire yourself. I'll handle it.
Chapter 4
Ares turned to his son, Harry, and unknowingly called out to his son for the last time:
-Harry, stay inside, hide in the basement, wait without a sound, come on, run!
+Okay..

Chapter 5
Ares rushed out, killing several demons around with his sword, and realized that the demons were quickly searching for something. What were they after? And at that moment, he suddenly heard a voice.
A demon brought Harry out of his hiding place and threw him in front of Ares. He prepared to take Harry to the cellars and looked at Ares and started laughing.
Although Ares desperately attacked to save his son, he could not counter the demon's power. The demon knocked Ares down in one move and took Harry in his right hand and began to fly.
Ares ran after the demon, he was in no mood anymore. He was living one of the most painful days in the world. He also did not forget the moment he lost his wife. And Ares started to cry from anger, he didn't remember what happened next, he passed out..

Chapter 5.1
He was spotted by a demon archer who was taking Harry to the cellars.
The archer immediately acted on his gun and had a single shot chance.
He had to shoot the arrow or the enemy would have left the target.
The archer aimed at the demon and fired the arrow. The arrow hit the demon's right wing and the demon fell, seriously injured. Meanwhile, Harry broke away from the demon's wings and crashed into the ground quickly. An unknown cave was waiting for him.
Chapter 6 (Rebirth)
Ares wakes up in his own village and in a friend's house.
-What happened to me like this..
+ You finally woke up. Thank God you are alive..
-Harry…
+ Please don't tire yourself, Ares, we will make them pay for all that has been done to us when the time comes. You should rest, your wound is very heavy.
Ares tries to get up.
+Wait, I understand your pain, but for now all we can do is be patient, believe me, I don't know what they are or who they are, but we won't die until we kill the demons! Listen a little more..
Ares falls into a deep sleep.

Chapter 6.1
Ares wakes up again, better than before, gets up and starts talking to Mason.
-How many days have passed, I can no longer comprehend the concept of time
+Exactly 12 days Ares..But I'm sure you look better now
-Yeah, I'm feeling fine..Any news from Harry? What happened to our people? How many people are alive now?
+Harry..sorry ares one of our archers said he shot the demon but he says he didn't see Harry..only a handful of our people are left. We escaped by hiding.
-God.. Please help!

Chapter 6.2
Ares goes out and starts to search the environment. He traces the environment.
And suddenly he sees that person, meets the woman who connects the main story. Her name is Isabella.
Isabella;
-Ares.. I know you don't know me but I can help you. My name is Isabella
+Isabella.. yes I'm having a little trouble recognizing it.. I guess you're not one of our townspeople, because I've never met a brunette before.
-Ahh yes I emigrated from an eastern country but I know you very well you saved our lives before your son was abducted you killed many demons and goblins so I am grateful to you.
+Is that so..but I couldn't save everyone..I'm so weak..
-You shouldn't think like that, Ares, this world is very valuable and meaningful. If you take the path that follows the meaning, it will offer you flowery gardens. The horizons you will chase are waiting for you.
-What do you mean Isabella?
+Sometimes all kinds of encounters are not a coincidence, Ares. Not every event that happens to us is a coincidence far from random, I know your pain is great, but I can help you..
-What help? Believe me, I'm very curious.
-I know a magician. He is from our eastern kingdom. He has many talents and can help you. Gaining a magic skill is not easy. You must reach Shangri-La. You must go beyond the horizon. Everything is in your hands.
+ Shangri-La .. Wait a minute, what are you talking about? It's a magical place in dreams. Shangri-La does not exist in this world!
-You're wrong, Ares. Shangri-La becomes a light to many people who purify themselves and choose beauties. The magician will bring you to Shangri-La, and you will move beyond the non-existent. Believe, just walk on this path..
+Alright.. So how can I reach the eastern land to that great wizard you mentioned?
-I'll give you a map. Follow the path. Somewhere behind the snowy lands, overcome the challenges that await you. You will get stronger as you overcome the challenges.
+ What about the wizard? how do i find it
The wizard will find you when the time comes. Everything will make sense.
+ Well .. I have to set out on the path my destiny has shown me. Maybe I can find my son and avenge all that has happened…
Ares sets out. He has to cross the difficult mountains. With a few swords he took with him, he takes his way towards those horizons that his destiny shows, without even knowing where he is going.
